message.content: Painting the Eiffel Tower is a fairly routine maintenance job that’s carried out every seven years. In practice, the whole process—from stripping old paint to applying fresh layers—takes roughly **two weeks**. A crew of skilled painters works on the tower’s iron lattice, carefully removing rust and old coatings before applying a new protective paint coat. The schedule is tightly coordinated to minimize disruption to visitors and to ensure the tower’s iconic appearance is preserved.
